column1: # Every leg of scripts/git-hooks/pre-push, classified (DEC-597): where it can run, and what happens where it cannot.
# Checked both ways by scripts/test-gate-legs.sh (run by pre-push): a leg missing here, or a row naming no leg, fails.
# key = the text of the leg's `echo "[pre-push] …"` line up to " (" ; columns are TAB-separated.
#   everywhere  runs on the PC, in a cloud session and in CI's gate job (a skip inside it is the leg's own, loud)
#   owed        may not run where it is; its script MUST record an OWED entry (scripts/owed-legs.sh) when it does not
#   pc-only     runs on every PC push, before the dk re-exec; a cloud session never runs it, and its work reaches master
#               only through a PC push, which does
#   info        a message, not a leg

column3: shellcheck, yamllint and hadolint are loud skips where absent
loud skip without the wasm32 target
two unreadable-file cases skip as root (a cloud session); they run on the PC and in CI
the live DB and mail round-trips self-skip everywhere: defect queue LIVE-ROUNDTRIPS-NOWHERE (DEC-599)
the fallback when cargo-nextest is absent
